// Define the state variables
val buyOrders = INPUTS.filter({ (box: Box) => box.R4[Coll[Byte]].isDefined }).map({ (box: Box) => (box.R4[Coll[Byte]].get, box.value) })
val sellOrders = INPUTS.filter({ (box: Box) => box.R5[Coll[Byte]].isDefined }).map({ (box: Box) => (box.R5[Coll[Byte]].get, box.value) })
val buySum = buyOrders.map({ (order: (Coll[Byte], Long)) => order._2 }).sum
val sellSum = sellOrders.map({ (order: (Coll[Byte], Long)) => order._2 }).sum
val tokens = CONTEXT.dataInputs(0).tokens.filter({ (token: Token) => token.id == "XEN" })
val xenBalance = tokens(0).amount

// Define the exchange logic
val price = sellSum.toDouble / buySum.toDouble
val buyOrder = buyOrders.minBy({ (order: (Coll[Byte], Long)) => order._2 })
val sellOrder = sellOrders.minBy({ (order: (Coll[Byte], Long)) => order._2 })
val buyAmount = if (buyOrder._2 > sellSum) sellSum else buyOrder._2
val sellAmount = buyAmount * price
val buyTokens = OUTPUTS(0).tokens.filter({ (token: Token) => token.id == "XEN" && token.value == xenBalance + sellAmount - buyAmount })
val sellTokens = OUTPUTS(1).tokens.filter({ (token: Token) => token.id == "XEN" && token.value == xenBalance - sellAmount + buyAmount })

// Define the validation logic
val isValid = buyOrders.nonEmpty && sellOrders.nonEmpty && buySum >= sellSum && buyOrder._2 >= sellSum && xenBalance >= buyAmount
val buyOrderOutput = OUTPUTS(0)
val sellOrderOutput = OUTPUTS(1)
val buyOrderValue = buyOrder._2 - sellSum
val sellOrderValue = sellOrder._2 - buyAmount
val newBuyOrder = buyOrderOutput.propositionBytes == buyOrder._1 && buyOrderOutput.value == buyOrderValue && buyOrderOutput.R4[Coll[Byte]].isDefined
val newSellOrder = sellOrderOutput.propositionBytes == sellOrder._1 && sellOrderOutput.value == sellOrderValue && sellOrderOutput.R5[Coll[Byte]].isDefined
val newBalances = OUTPUTS(2).value == INPUTS(0).value - buyAmount && OUTPUTS(3).value == INPUTS(1).value + sellAmount

// Define the final output
val finalOutput = if (isValid && newBuyOrder && newSellOrder && newBalances) {
    OUTPUTS(2) :: OUTPUTS(3) :: Nil
} else {
    OUTPUTS
}

// Return the final output
finalOutput
